events.text:
I removed the duplicate `procurement-ops@halcyon.example` entry from the notify list. I left the rest of the config as it was.

I kept `second_approval_threshold` at 9500 even though AP-7 says $10,000. AP-7 allows stricter thresholds in procurement workflows. Kwame set 9500 on purpose after audit finding IA-114, which found purchases split to land just under $10,000. Changing it back to 10000 would undo that fix.

The first approval (cost center manager) and the second approver (procurement lead) already match AP-7.

If you still want the threshold at $10,000, check with Kwame first.
